title: Network Participation Agreements: Repeat Repayments and the Repayment Interest Rate
content:
A Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** is paid by capitation. On such an agreement, a claim payment remittance only ever repays an over-recovery. When Cascade has had to repay the same agreement more than once, the interest rate on the repayment rises.

**Clause.** The repeat-repayment add-on to the repayment interest rate is set by the claim payment remittances on the agreement dated fewer than 24 whole months before today, the current repayment included:

- three or more add 4 points to the annual rate;
- exactly two add 2 points;
- only one adds nothing.

## Counting the remittances

- Count every remittance on the agreement whose component is a claim payment and whose date is fewer than 24 whole months before today. The current repayment is counted.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the remittance date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the remittance date's day of the month.
- Capitation payments and prompt-pay interest payments are not claim payments and are not counted.

## Count table

| Claim payment remittances in the window | Points added to the annual rate |
|---|---|
| 1 (the current repayment only) | None |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 4 |

## Hypothetical illustration

An agreement shows three claim payment remittances: the current one, one 9 whole months before today and one 30 whole months before today. Only two fall within the window, so 2 points are added.
